description: Indexed snapshots with source timestamps, vault/token-program addresses and raw reserve/supply amounts. New tokens and pools on Solana (pump.fun, LetsBonk, Raydium LaunchLab, Meteora DBC, PumpSwap, Raydium AMM and CPMM) from the last N minutes with mint and freeze authority, stored Token-2022 extension checks (pending or stale checks stay unknown), liquidity and lock, price and market cap (pump.fun curves and AMM pools) with pump.fun curve progress, creator history and links to past collapses, and the first-buyer funding graph: same-block buyers, wallets funded by the creator or by one shared address, known snipers. Each launch has section provenance and observation ages under data, plus a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Up to 20 launches per answer, or as many as the plan's batch size. Windows over 60 minutes or more than 20 launches cost more. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.
